---
title: "7. Algorithmic Game Theory and Computational Mechanism Design"
---

::: {.module-meta}
**Duration:** 14 weeks  
**Outcome:** Analyse and implement strategic mechanisms computationally.
:::

## Core topics

Computational equilibria; price of anarchy; routing; matching; auctions; VCG; Myerson; combinatorial auctions; approximation; automated and differentiable mechanism design.

## Essential resources

- Roughgarden, T. (2016). *Twenty Lectures on Algorithmic Game Theory*. Cambridge University Press. <https://timroughgarden.org/books.html>
- Nisan, N., Roughgarden, T., Tardos, É., & Vazirani, V. V. (Eds.). (2007). *Algorithmic Game Theory*. Cambridge University Press.
- Stanford **CS364A: Algorithmic Game Theory** — <https://timroughgarden.org/f13/f13.html>

## Milestone

Implement benchmark auctions and matching mechanisms; then build a small differentiable/neural mechanism and test incentive violations.
